prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game GUI facility background candidate for the Element Maze JRPG static prototype
Primary request: Create a new 20:9 overscan master image for the Ice-region magic shop facility. This is a review candidate master, not a final replacement asset.
Reference intent: Match the mature fantasy GUI mood of the existing magic shop and the previously shown Ice magic shop v01 candidate: dark wet timber, shelves of spellbooks and glass bottles, brass lanterns, blue ice lanterns, sea-fogged harbor windows, coastal winter atmosphere. Use them as style and composition references only, not a direct copy.
Scene/backdrop: Interior of an ice-lantern magic shop on a frost-tide harbor: wet dark wood shelves, brass and blue-glass lanterns, sealed spellbooks, star charts, crystal tools, hanging charms, sea-fogged arched windows on the left with distant cold harbor silhouettes, salt frost on glass and metal. Keep readable left and middle background depth for GUI panels.
Subject: Eve, adult female magic shop keeper, calm and professional, modest layered navy-and-cream winter robe with fur trim, dark hair with cold blue highlights, holding a spellbook or small ice lantern. She should feel intelligent and grounded, not seductive, and distinct from the innkeeper and synthesis artisan.
Style/medium: polished 2D anime fantasy game background, painterly JRPG facility art, mature and grounded, detailed but not cluttered.
Composition/framing: 20:9 wide landscape overscan canvas, designed to crop safely down to 1672x941 16:9. Put Eve as a medium-close half-body figure in the right foreground. Her face should land in the upper-right safe zone with breathing room above and to the right, not touching any image edge. Keep her core shoulders and torso visible after a centered or slightly-left 16:9 crop. Hands, spellbook, lantern, and lower work surface may be partly hidden by GUI panels. Preserve extra horizontal environment on both sides for CSS cover/crop adjustment.
Lighting/mood: cold blue coastal light mixed with warm amber brass lanterns and icy cyan magical glow, quiet winter harbor magic-shop atmosphere.
Color palette: cold blue, deep navy, dark wood brown, warm brass amber, small cyan crystal highlights.
Constraints: no in-image text, no readable signs, no UI panels, no logos, no runtime IDs, no watermark, no captions.
negative_prompt: text, captions, logo, UI panels, signs with readable words, runtime IDs, cropped face, face at image edge, tiny distant NPC, full-body far shot, seductive costume, plain white snowfield, empty ice cave, modern objects, extra fingers, broken hands, warped tools, unreadable clutter, overexposed pure white ice, image with no usable left/middle background depth.
accepted_or_rejected_reason: Superseded after owner review: the Ice magic shop keeper looked too similar to the Ice guild candidate in face, hair, eyes, and clothing silhouette.
agent_notes: Overscan master generated for the facility background crop pipeline. It is intentionally not a 16:9 GUI background and is not installed as the GUI background. Two non-destructive crop trials were generated in temp for owner visual review before any cropped-candidate metadata is written. Superseded by v02 to separate the magic shop keeper from the guild candidate while preserving Ice-region clothing context.
